issues.description: The problem statement (Aufgabe 06) requires counting the number of Wanderwege that lead to Gemeinden with more than 500,000 male inhabitants (einwohner_m > 500000). The reference solution (solution_repository/aufgabe06.sql) uses the opposite comparison (einwohner_m < 500000), which contradicts the task description and will produce the wrong result. This mismatch between problem and solution is likely to confuse students comparing their queries to the provided solution or using the solution as a reference.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the reference solution to match the problem statement by using the greater-than comparison. For example, change the WHERE clause to: AND einwohner_m > 500000 (i.e., SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Gemeinde, Wanderweg_zu_Gemeinde WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Wanderweg_zu_Gemeinde.gemeindeschluessel AND einwohner_m > 500000).
